observation_summary: The regularized Gamma function was returning values with insufficient precision because the default epsilon constant was set to 10e-9 instead of a value appropriate for double-precision calculations.
reasoning_summary: The fix involved changing the value of a static constant `DEFAULT_EPSILON` from `10e-9` to `10e-15`. This is a classic case of an incorrectly initialized constant value, which falls under the 'Assignment/Initialization' category in ODC.
evidence_used: The fix_diff_oracle shows a change to the value of the constant DEFAULT_EPSILON.
The bug report states that the default epsilon was set to 10e-9 and should be set to the highest possible accuracy for double precision.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the epsilon affects the accuracy of the algorithm, the fix itself is a simple change to a constant value, not a change to the logic or implementation of the algorithm.
